title: Discord Rich Presence
enableHint: Off until you turn it on. Nothing is published and no connection is opened while it is off.
configured: Uses the NihongoTracker Companion Discord application and its built-in artwork.
appIdHint: Create an application in the Discord Developer Portal, upload your icons under Rich Presence → Art Assets, and paste its ID here.
largeImageHint: Asset key of the image used when there is no cover, or when showing one would give away the title.
disconnected: Not connected. Discord may be closed; it will be retried on its own.
genericModeHint: Always publishes "Japanese immersion" with no title and no cover, whatever you are on.
idlePresence: Keep the presence while a VN is in the background
idlePresenceHint: When a detected visual novel is not focused (or you are AFK), it shows "Idling in <title>" instead of going empty. Turn off to clear it like before.
profileButtonHint: Links to your public NihongoTracker profile.

preview.title: What other people see
preview.hint: Not a mock-up: this is the exact presence that would be published right now.
preview.off: Rich Presence is off. Nothing is published.
preview.idle: Nothing is being watched or read, so the presence is empty.
preview.blocked: "{{label}}" is on your blacklist: nothing at all is published.

reason.adult: This work is classified as adult. For VNs, the previous rule applies until the cover rating is available.
reason.unresolved: The media could not be resolved, so the file name is never published.
reason.adultimage: This VN cover is classified as adult on NihongoTracker, so the title and cover are hidden.

blacklist.title: Never show these
blacklist.hint: A work or a program on this list publishes nothing at all — not even a generic activity.
